our_interpretation: The claim concerns Microsoft’s internal managerial guidance, rather than Copilot’s technical capabilities or actual adoption by managers.
Instructing includes providing endorsed instructions for this use. It does not necessarily mean making Copilot use compulsory.
For this undated ongoing practice, I use July–September 2024, the latest completed fiscal quarter before publication. The post does not identify the guidance’s issue date.
Restrictions on letting AI determine rewards would not contradict permission to use it when drafting justifications.
